about: What each snack looks like and how it is served, for the image prompts (doc 25.4). scripts/generate-images.mjs adds the house style. Every product is vegetarian.
style: Professional food photography, 45-degree angle, bright soft natural window light, warm cream background, realistic, appetising, sharp focus on the food, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no packaging print, no people, no hands

looks.sev-puri: Mumbai sev puri: six flat crisp puris topped with potato, onion, green and tamarind chutneys and a generous heap of fine yellow sev and coriander, on a steel plate
looks.pani-puri: Pani puri: six small round hollow crisp golden puris, a few filled with potato and chickpeas, with a small jug of green tangy water and tamarind chutney, on a steel plate
looks.bhadang: Kolhapuri bhadang: a spicy heap of roasted puffed rice tossed with red chilli, garlic, peanuts, fried curry leaves and roasted gram, in a clay bowl
looks.poha-chivda: Maharashtrian poha chivda: a crunchy yellow mix of thin roasted flattened rice, peanuts, roasted gram, curry leaves, raisins and cashews, in a steel bowl
looks.chakli: Maharashtrian chakli: crisp dark-golden spiral-shaped discs with spiky ridged edges, stacked in a wicker basket
looks.shankarpali: Shankarpali: small crisp diamond-shaped fried dough sweets, pale golden, heaped in a brass bowl
looks.karanji: Maharashtrian karanji: half-moon shaped fried pastries with finely crimped edges, pale golden, one broken to show a sweet coconut and dry fruit filling, on a white plate
looks.anarsa: Maharashtrian anarsa: round flat golden-brown fried rice and jaggery cakes coated in white poppy seeds on top, on a brass plate
looks.chirote: Maharashtrian chirote: round layered flaky fried pastries with many delicate layers, dusted with powdered sugar, on a white plate
looks.ukadiche-modak: Ukadiche modak: steamed white rice-flour dumplings with pleated tops pointed like a teardrop, glistening with a drop of ghee, arranged on a banana leaf
looks.besan-ladoo: Besan ladoo: round smooth golden-yellow roasted gram-flour sweet balls with chopped pistachio on top, on a brass plate
looks.tilgul-ladoo: Tilgul ladoo: small round sesame and jaggery sweet balls, light brown with visible sesame seeds and peanuts, in a clay bowl
looks.gul-poli: Maharashtrian gul poli: thin round flatbreads stuffed with jaggery and sesame, crisp with brown spots, stacked with a spoon of ghee on a steel plate
looks.amba-barfi: Amba barfi: neat squares of bright yellow-orange mango and milk fudge topped with pistachio slivers, on a white plate
looks.shrikhand: Maharashtrian shrikhand: thick creamy strained yogurt sweet, pale saffron yellow, swirled in a small clay bowl and topped with saffron strands, pistachio and almond slivers
looks.mawa-cake: Mumbai mawa cakes: small round golden-brown cup cakes with cracked tops and a single almond on each, arranged on a wooden board beside a cup of tea
looks.nankhatai: Nankhatai: round domed pale golden shortbread cookies with cracked tops and a pistachio sliver in the middle, stacked on a white plate
looks.cut-mirchi: Guntur cut mirchi from a street cart: thick green chilli bajjis fried golden, cut into short chunks and fried a second time until extra crisp, tossed with chopped raw onion, lemon juice, chaat masala and coriander, served on a paper plate on a steel cart counter
looks.aratikaya-bajji: Andhra aratikaya bajji: thin lengthwise slices of raw green banana dipped in gram-flour batter and deep-fried into flat golden crisp fritters, a few overlapping on a sheet of plain paper on a steel plate, with green chutney
looks.bangaladumpa-bajji: Andhra potato bajji: thin round potato slices coated in a light golden gram-flour batter and deep-fried, puffed and crisp, piled on a steel plate with sliced onion and a green chilli
looks.vankaya-bajji: Andhra vankaya bajji: round slices of purple brinjal in a crisp golden gram-flour batter, the purple skin showing at the edges, stacked on a steel plate with peanut chutney in a small bowl
looks.uggani-bajji: Kurnool uggani bajji: a mound of soft yellow tempered puffed-rice upma with peanuts, curry leaves and green chilli, topped with two crisp mirchi bajjis broken on top, served on a banana leaf on a steel plate, street breakfast
looks.purnam-boorelu: Andhra purnam boorelu: round deep-fried sweet dumplings with a thin crisp golden-brown rice and urad dal batter shell, one cut open to show a dark brown chana dal and jaggery filling, a spoon of ghee on top, on a brass plate
looks.kaalan: Chennai street kaalan: chopped mushrooms fried crisp and simmered in a spicy dark red-brown gravy, served in a small steel bowl, topped with chopped raw onion, coriander and a squeeze of lemon
looks.atho: Chennai street atho, vegetarian: Burmese-style noodles tossed with shredded cabbage, carrot and onion, fried garlic and tamarind, crushed fried crackers on top, served in a paper boat with a small bowl of clear vegetable soup beside it
looks.thattu-vadai-set: Salem thattu vadai set: two crisp round thattai crackers sandwiching a layer of grated carrot, beetroot, chopped onion and coriander with red and green chutneys, four sets stacked on a steel plate
looks.masala-puri: Bengaluru masala puri: crushed crisp puris drowned in a warm brown green-pea masala gravy, topped with chopped onion, grated carrot, coriander and fine yellow sev, in a steel bowl
looks.gobi-manchurian: Street-style gobi manchurian, dry: crisp fried cauliflower florets tossed in a glossy red-brown chilli and garlic sauce with spring onion greens and sesame seeds, served in a paper boat
